term.name: Conversion rate
term.def: The share of visitors who actually do the thing you want, like buy, sign up or book a demo. If 100 people visit and 3 buy, that's a 3% conversion rate.

stories.headline: AI shopping assistants are sending way more buyers to stores this Black Friday
stories.summary: Adobe says US shoppers spent $7.1 billion online on Thanksgiving and forecasts $12.9 billion for Black Friday, up 9.2% from last year. It expects traffic from AI assistants to retail sites to rise 95% on Black Friday, and says those AI-referred shoppers convert at a 90% higher rate.
stories.takeaway: Buyers are starting to ask an AI before they visit your site, so making sure AI tools understand and recommend your product is becoming its own marketing job.

stories.headline: OpenAI fixes a billing mistake, so heavy users hit limits faster
stories.summary: OpenAI says a mistake at the GPT-6.2 launch on November 17 gave most users a discount on usage they shouldn't have had. After the fix, people reach their limits 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol. To soften it, Go, Plus, Pro and Business users get one extra usage reset, and Business users get free Fast Mode through the end of 2026.
stories.takeaway: When you take something away, pair the bad news with a make-good. A small gift up front keeps a fix from feeling like a price hike.

stories.headline: Nutanix beats its own forecast and starts hunting for a new CEO
stories.summary: The cloud infrastructure company reported $772.4 million in quarterly revenue, up 15% from a year ago, and 15% growth in annual recurring revenue. CEO Rajiv Ramaswami said results beat all of its guided metrics. He'll step down once the board finds a successor and stay on as a senior advisor.
stories.takeaway: Announcing a leadership change alongside strong numbers is deliberate. Good news gives the market a calm frame for the bigger change.

stories.headline: Marketers now spend about 15% of their budgets on AI, report says
stories.summary: A new Salesbox report on B2B content syndication cites Gartner's 2026 CMO Spend Survey: CMOs put an average of 15.3% of marketing budgets toward AI, while overall budgets stay flat at 7.8% of company revenue. Only 30% of marketing leaders report mature AI readiness, even though 70% call AI leadership a critical goal.
stories.takeaway: Flat budgets plus a bigger AI slice means something else got cut. If you sell to marketers, show what your product replaces, not just what it adds.

stories.headline: Canada adds C$700 million to help businesses pay for AI computing
stories.summary: Canada's AI Compute Access Fund now totals C$1 billion. The government will cover up to 80% of eligible computing costs for businesses that choose qualifying sovereign cloud providers.
stories.takeaway: Government subsidies can tip a buying decision. If you qualify for a program like this, "80% covered" belongs right in your sales pitch.

stories.headline: AI agent visits to US retailers jump about 150-fold
stories.summary: Security firm Human Security estimates a 150-fold increase in AI agent traffic to US retailers this holiday season. Meta's Muse assistant made up nearly 70% of that AI-driven traffic.
stories.takeaway: Your next "visitor" might be a bot shopping for a human. Clear pricing and product facts on your site help agents pick you.

stories.headline: Tencent Cloud and Tec-Do team up on AI for advertisers
stories.summary: Ad-tech company Tec-Do signed a strategic partnership with Tencent Cloud covering marketing AI models, computing power and Tencent's WorkBuddy agent ecosystem. Tec-Do says it works with about 7 million media publishers and more than 150 million creators.
stories.takeaway: Partnership announcements lean on big reach numbers. They signal scale fast, but the real proof comes later in customer results.

stories.headline: Microsoft exposes an AI hacking toolkit used by state-backed groups
stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence detailed ARTEX, a framework that hands parts of a cyberattack to specialized AI agents. One campaign it tracked logged more than 151,000 failed sign-in attempts, peaking at 2,900 a minute.
stories.takeaway: Threat research is marketing too. Publishing what you found builds trust and makes the case for your security products without a hard sell.

stories.headline: Indian startup funding halves in a quiet week, led by Finnable
stories.summary: Indian startups raised $146.7 million from November 23 to 27, down 49.3% from the week before, across 15 deals. Lending tech company Finnable led with a $43.8 million Series C, and AI startups together raised more than $64 million.
stories.takeaway: Holiday weeks are slow for deals. Timing matters for announcements, so big news usually waits for a week when people are paying attention.

stories.headline: CredAble buys a majority stake in AI regulation startup Reql
stories.summary: Fintech platform CredAble acquired a 70% stake in Reql, an AI-native startup that tracks regulatory rules. It's one of a couple of acquisitions in India's startup scene this week.
stories.takeaway: Buying a stake instead of the whole company is a lower-risk way to add a new capability, and it gives both brands room to keep their own identity.
